transcript.answer: I found the threshold in the specs but not in the implementation code. A new fact is compared against existing valid facts, and any match at or above the threshold marks the old fact as contradicted. The data-model section of `specs/2-agent-memory/spec.md` and task T062 in `specs/2-agent-memory/tasks.md` both give the same 0.92 value. The implementation is in `libs/server-core/src/work/memory/facts.ts`. I did not open that file, so I can't confirm the constant there.
